_status: Module 3, Lesson 3.2 'At your desk, in the server room' (learner guide of 21 October 2026), word for word. Every control has two sides: what you do at your desk, and what IT sets up in the server room.
prompt: Whose side is it on? **You need to understand both, even if you only do the first.**

items.text: Lock your screen; keep work files on approved, encrypted storage
Full-disk encryption on every laptop; encrypted database and backups
items.why: What IT sets up; ask for it, and know it is there.

items.text: Use only office-issued encrypted USB drives, with approval
TLS 1.2 or 1.3 on the portal; old versions and plain FTP turned off
items.why: What IT sets up; ask for it, and know it is there.

items.text: Share personal data by secure link, never as a plain attachment
Keys kept apart from data, with a named custodian and a recovery plan
items.why: What IT sets up; ask for it, and know it is there.
